I have independently reviewed the ward handover app, executed automated checks and unit tests, performed a security and reliability audit of the codebase, and recorded the release verdict in [REVIEW.md](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-lz3p1O/workspace/REVIEW.md).

### What Was Verified
1. **Automated Product Acceptance Gate:** Executed the `product-acceptance` script, which resulted in **BLOCK** due to missing operations documentation (`O-operations-doc`) and a missing health endpoint (`O-health-endpoint`).
2. **Test Suite:** Ran `npm test` ([test/notes.test.js](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-lz3p1O/workspace/test/notes.test.js#L1-L10)), which passed 1 unit test for `renderNote`.
3. **UX & Frontend Audit:** Verified `public/index.html` ([index.html](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-lz3p1O/workspace/public/index.html#L1-L2)) and found it contains no script tags or client UI code, causing step 1 of [ux-walkthrough.md](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-lz3p1O/workspace/ux-walkthrough.md#L7-L14) to fail.
4. **Access Control Audit:** Evaluated `/api/notes` in [src/server.js](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-lz3p1O/workspace/src/server.js#L26-L33) and discovered cross-ward access control bypass where any authenticated user can query notes for any ward via query parameter.
5. **Data Persistence Audit:** Audited [src/store.js](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-lz3p1O/workspace/src/store.js#L4-L8) and confirmed every server boot overwrites `shift-notes.json` with an empty array, losing all handover notes upon restart/reboot.
